_readme: GENERATED by npm run docs:capture:day-to-day. Real contractor screens, invented data only. Re-run when a contractor screen changes.

entries.name: 04-open-the-job
entries.guideLine: Open the job — read the FULL checklist
entries.onScreen: Dashboard → today's job → Job Checklist
entries.narration: Start in your dashboard. Today's job is at the top of Upcoming Jobs — tap Job Checklist to open it.

entries.name: 05-read-the-full-checklist
entries.guideLine: Open the job — read the FULL checklist
entries.onScreen: The job checklist: the clean, the time, the address, 0 of 32 tasks
entries.narration: This is the whole job — every room, every line. Read all 32 tasks before you leave the house, not when you get there.

entries.name: 06-full-checklist-scroll
entries.guideLine: Open the job — read the FULL checklist
entries.onScreen: The entire checklist, top to bottom (tall image for a slow scroll)
entries.narration: Scroll it end to end: Kitchen, Bathrooms, then all rooms.

entries.name: 07-access-and-property-notes
entries.guideLine: Read access details and property notes
entries.onScreen: Access notes, office notes and dispatch notes on the checklist
entries.narration: Read the notes before you go. Gate code, pets, and anything the office wants you to know — here, don't ring the doorbell.

entries.name: 08-view-job-details
entries.guideLine: Read access details and property notes
entries.onScreen: Dashboard → View job details: home size, pets, access and office notes
entries.narration: On the dashboard, View job details shows the home itself — size, pets, and the same access notes.

entries.name: 09-ringer-on
entries.guideLine: Phone charged, ringer ON, data working
entries.onScreen: Profile → SMS Notifications: On
entries.narration: Charge your phone and keep the ringer on. The office texts you job links — including your photo link — so keep SMS notifications on.

entries.name: 10-supplies-ready
entries.guideLine: Supplies loaded and ready
entries.onScreen: Your supply checklist — the kit list from onboarding
entries.narration: Load your kit the night before: solutions, tools, gloves. This is the same supply list you checked off in onboarding.

entries.name: 12-arrive-inside-your-window
entries.guideLine: Arrive inside your window — late? call first
entries.onScreen: Your arrival window and the address, top of the checklist
entries.narration: Arrive inside your window — this one is 10 to 11 AM. Running late? Call the office before the window starts, not after.

entries.name: 13-check-in
entries.guideLine: Greet the client, confirm access
entries.onScreen: Dashboard → Check In
entries.narration: Greet the client and confirm how you're getting in — here, the side gate. Then tap Check In.

entries.name: 14-ask-about-pets
entries.guideLine: Ask about pets — have them moved
entries.onScreen: View job details → Pets: Dog — Biscuit
entries.narration: Ask about pets before you start. This home has a dog, Biscuit — ask the client to move him to another room.

entries.name: 15-before-photos
entries.guideLine: Take BEFORE photos of every area
entries.onScreen: The BEFORE photos page (the link is texted when you check in)
entries.narration: Checking in texts you your before-photos link. Before you touch anything, photograph every area.

entries.name: 16-before-photos-every-area
entries.guideLine: Take BEFORE photos of every area
entries.onScreen: Before photos added for every room
entries.narration: Kitchen, bathrooms, living room, bedrooms — every area. Then tap Submit before photos.

entries.name: 18-work-in-order
entries.guideLine: Work the checklist in order
entries.onScreen: The checklist starts with Kitchen — work top to bottom
entries.narration: Work the checklist in order. Start at the top — Kitchen — and go line by line.

entries.name: 19-check-off-as-you-go
entries.guideLine: Check items off AS you finish them
entries.onScreen: Three Kitchen tasks checked off, the rest still open
entries.narration: Tap each line the moment you finish it — not all at once at the end. The office sees your progress as you go.

entries.name: 20-finish-one-area
entries.guideLine: Finish one area before starting another
entries.onScreen: Kitchen shows 'Tasks done' before Bathrooms begins
entries.narration: Finish one area before you start the next. When every Kitchen line is checked, it says Tasks done — then move on.

entries.name: 21-ask-before-moving-furniture
entries.guideLine: Ask before moving furniture — put it back
entries.onScreen: If the client says leave it: Skip with reason
entries.narration: Ask before you move furniture, and put it back where it was. If the client says don't touch it, skip that line with a reason — never just leave it blank.

entries.name: 23-final-walkthrough
entries.guideLine: Walk every area one final time
entries.onScreen: 32 of 32 tasks, 100%
entries.narration: Walk every area one last time with the checklist in hand. Every line checked: 32 of 32.

entries.name: 24-after-photos
entries.guideLine: Take AFTER photos of every area
entries.onScreen: AFTER photos for every room
entries.narration: Take after photos of every area — the same angles as your before shots.

entries.name: 25-report-any-issue
entries.guideLine: Report ANY issue — before you leave
entries.onScreen: Checklist → Problem on site? → Report an issue to dispatch
entries.narration: Anything wrong — damage, something broken, something you couldn't finish? Report it before you leave, not after.

entries.name: 26-report-issue-details
entries.guideLine: Report ANY issue — before you leave
entries.onScreen: Say exactly what happened, then Send to dispatch now
entries.narration: Be specific: what, where, and whether it was already there. Dispatch acts on exactly what you write.

entries.name: 27-finish-checklist
entries.guideLine: Mark the job complete in your dashboard
entries.onScreen: Finish checklist — notify the office
entries.narration: Every line done? Tap Finish checklist. That tells the office the clean is done.

entries.name: 28-checklist-complete
entries.guideLine: Mark the job complete in your dashboard
entries.onScreen: Checklist complete — the app tells you to mark the job complete
entries.narration: The checklist confirms it — and reminds you of the last step: mark the job complete in your dashboard.

entries.name: 29-mark-complete
entries.guideLine: Mark the job complete in your dashboard
entries.onScreen: Dashboard → Mark Complete (after you've checked in)
entries.narration: Back in your dashboard, the job shows Checked In. Tap Mark Complete.

entries.name: 30-marked-complete
entries.guideLine: Mark the job complete in your dashboard
entries.onScreen: Sent to the office for review — upload your photos to release payout
entries.narration: The job goes to the office for review. Upload your before and after photos to release your payout.

entries.name: 32-after-photos-submitted
entries.guideLine: Photos in. Checklist done. Nothing left for the client to fix.
entries.onScreen: After photos submitted — payout in 1–2 business days
entries.narration: Photos in. You'll see your payout in Stripe within one to two business days.

entries.name: 33-completed-jobs
entries.guideLine: Photos in. Checklist done. Nothing left for the client to fix.
entries.onScreen: Dashboard → Completed Jobs, payout pending
entries.narration: The job moves to Completed. Checklist done, photos in — nothing left for the client to fix.

entries.name: 35-move-up-a-tier
entries.guideLine: That is how you move up a tier and earn more per job.
entries.onScreen: Your tier and rate on every job (Foundation → Proven → Elite)
entries.narration: Do this on every job. It's how you move up a tier — Foundation, Proven, Elite — and earn more per job.

entries.name: 37-office-number
entries.guideLine: Unsure about anything? Call the office.
entries.onScreen: Job lookup → Need help? Call (844) 735-2070
entries.narration: Not sure? Call the office. You're never in trouble for asking.
